name: Kanata no Mori
source:
Shinichi works at the newspaper company and travels around Europe together with Mina who he met during college years. But Mina suddenly disappears during the trip. He find a witness claiming she entered the "Lost Forest" where vampire lived. Shinichi follows Mina, but gets a serious injury during a wolf attack. He finds shelter in a mansion he stumbles upon in the forest. He is greeted by the owner, two maids and Mina who lost memory. He stays at the mansion to treat his wound, but at the same time tries to restore Mina memory.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
信一在报社工作，与大学时代认识的米娜一同周游欧洲。旅途中，米娜却突然失踪。一名目击者声称，她走进了有吸血鬼栖息的“迷失森林”。信一追随米娜而去，却在遭到狼群袭击时身负重伤，最后躲进森林中偶然发现的一座宅邸。

迎接他的是宅邸主人、两名女仆，以及已经失去记忆的米娜。信一留下疗伤，同时也开始尝试帮助米娜找回记忆。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
